rows.note: Adopts the hand-named fixture; the file has no generated header.
source: '' FVAR / FVARS DAT data: every length boundary of both encodings, both signs.
'' FVAR  emits the RFVAR  form (unsigned, 1..4 bytes, 29 bits max).
'' FVARS emits the RFVARS form (signed, 1..4 bytes, -$1000_0000..$0FFF_FFFF).
'' Reported against v1.55.9: a non-negative FVARS value was rejected as
'' "FVAR/FVARS data is too big", and once accepted was encoded by its unsigned
'' length (FVARS 100 as the single byte $64, which RFVARS reads back as -28).
